# secret-publication

Pushes a Secret this cluster holds into a lab store.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| key | string | *(required)* | Key it is written under in the store. Required.  It used to be derived from the producing cluster's identity, on both sides, which is what made a mismatch between them possible at all.  |
| keys | list of string | `[]` | Which keys of the Secret travel. Empty means the whole Secret, as one value.  |
| namespace | string | *(required)* | Namespace holding the Secret to push. Required. |
| secret | string | *(required)* | Name of the Secret to push, as it is called here. Required.  What it is called where it is read is the subscriber's choice, and neither name is one the other side has to know.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| secretStore | [SECRET_STORE](../signatures/SECRET_STORE.md) | A named store an ExternalSecret reads from, and whether it may be written to. |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| publication | [PUBLISHED_SECRET](../signatures/PUBLISHED_SECRET.md) | A value one cluster pushed into a lab store, and where to read it. |
